items.title: Bitcoin briefly drops to $17K on Kraken, exchange upholds trades
items.snippet: Kraken said all orders were processed correctly and found no evidence of a security breach or compromised accounts.

items.title: South Korean exchanges halt CYBER transfers amid suspected bridge exploit
items.snippet: Cyber reported unexpected minting of CYBER tokens on Solana, followed by tokens moving out of its Ethereum bridge lockbox, prompting an investigation.
items.note: Негативний тон для ETH, SOL за ключовими словами -- варто звернути увагу.

items.title: Chainflip confirms $12M hack, offers attacker 10% bounty
items.snippet: Chainflip offered the attacker a 10% bounty to return 90% of the stolen funds by Nov. 23, promising to treat the return as a white-hat recovery and withdraw law enforcement complaints.
items.note: Негативний тон для загального ринку за ключовими словами -- варто звернути увагу.
